name: Start

block.name: Start
block.description: Unified workflow entry point for chat, manual and API runs
block.longDescription: Collect structured inputs and power manual runs, API executions, and deployed chat experiences from a single start block.

subBlocks.title: Inputs
subBlocks.description: Add custom fields beyond the built-in input, conversationId, and files fields.

block.bestPractices:
- The Start block always exposes "input", "conversationId", and "files" fields for chat compatibility.
- Add custom input format fields to collect additional structured data.
- Test manual runs by pre-filling default values inside the input format fields.
